# CANDIDATE: ATR_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When recent ATR contracts to a low percentile (lowest 20% of the last 20 periods), a break above the prior 20-bar high with expanding volume (>1.3x average) and strong close (upper 50% of range) often captures the ensuing volatility expansion. This targets low-VIX (<15) environments where compression precedes expansion.

## Mechanism

Calculate ATR(14) over the last 20 periods. If current ATR is in the lowest 20% of that lookback, enter long on the first 5-minute bar that:
- Closes above the highest high of the prior 20 bars
- Has volume > 1.3× the average 5-minute volume of those 20 bars
- Closes in the upper 50% of its range (close - low) / (high - low) > 0.5
Exit: Initial stop at the low of the breakout bar (chart-stop). Target: 2×ATR from entry or trailing stop of 20% off the highest high since entry, whichever is hit first. Avoid high-VIX (>25) or news-driven spikes.
